verdict.rationale: GitLab docs claim AI agents can turn issues into merge requests and remediate vulnerabilities detected by integrated scanners (SAST, SCA, Secret Detection, DAST), with findings surfaced in MRs/IDEs, directly supporting automated vulnerability fix generation and application. However, this is vendor marketing copy without hands-on evidence, workflow specifics, or independent corroboration of accuracy/reliability of auto-generated fixes. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that AI-generated fixes work correctly, details on the remediation workflow and guardrails, and community evidence confirming real-world effectiveness.
